sources.title: google/gemma-4-31B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 features a context window of up to 256K tokens and maintains multilingual support in over 140 languages. Featuring both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, Gemma 4 is well-suited for tasks like text generation, coding, and reasoning. The models are available in five distinct sizes: E2B, E4B, 12B, 26B A4B, and 31B.

sources.title: Gemma 4 31B — Enterprise-Grade Local LLM | gemma4.dev
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 31B is Google's flagship Gemma 4 model with 31B parameters and 256K token context. Ideal for production RAG pipelines, long-document analysis, and enterprise inference servers.

sources.title: gemma-4-31b-it Model by Google | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Gemma 4 31B IT is an open multimodal model built by Google DeepMind that handles text and image inputs, can process video as sequences of frames, and generates text output.
